spells.name: Lance of the Phoenix
spells.comps: V, S, M (an arrow, javelin, or similar projectile)
spells.summary: You hurl a lance of pure intense flame at a target you can see within range. Make a spell attack roll against the target, ignoring the effects of cover. On a hit, you deal 12d4 fire damage to the target. If you miss, you deal half damage. This attack scores a critical hit if the number on the d20 is a 19 or higher. The first time you cast a spell after a short rest, you suffer no adverse effects. If you cast this spell again before you finish a short rest, you take fire damage equal to 1d10 + Level of the spell slot, immediately after you cast it. The fire spreads in a 5 ft. radius from the target. It ignites flammable objects in the area and the path of the arrow that aren't being worn or carried. At Higher Levels: +2d4 per slot level above 3rd.
spells.note: Homebrew · granted by the Long Jewel Shard

features.name: Druidic
features.desc: You know the secret language of druids.

features.name: Spellcasting
features.desc: Prepare WIS mod + druid level spells from the druid list each day.

features.name: Wild Shape
features.desc: Action: transform into a beast you have seen for half your druid level in hours.

features.name: Summon Wildfire Spirit
features.desc: Spend Wild Shape: summon a Wildfire Spirit that can teleport allies.

features.name: Enhanced Bond
features.desc: +1d8 to fire damage or healing spells while your spirit is summoned.

features.name: Cauterizing Flames
features.desc: Reaction when a creature dies near your spirit: create a flame that heals or burns.

features.name: Fey Ancestry
features.desc: Advantage vs being charmed; magic can't put you to sleep.

features.name: Elf Weapon Training
features.desc: Longsword, shortsword, shortbow and longbow proficiency.

features.name: Darkvision
features.desc: You can see in dim light within 60 ft as if it were bright light, and in darkness as if it were dim light (shades of gray only).

features.name: Rustic Hospitality
features.desc: Common folk will shelter and hide you, unless it endangers them.

features.name: Elemental Adept
features.desc: Choose acid, cold, fire, lightning or thunder: spells ignore resistance and treat 1s as 2s.

features.name: Spirit Merge
features.desc: Using a Wild Shape charge, Shadowheart can summon his Wildfire Spirit within him, allowing him to use Flame Seed and Fiery Teleportation, as well as granting him a 30 ft. flight speed. As Shadowheart summons his Wildfire Spirit, he begins to glow bright orange in his chest before fire bursts out of his back forming two fiery wings and his shoulders and hair begin to burn with a harmless translucent fire, making it seem like his clothes and hair ARE the fire. His eyes glow a deep orange.

hb.effNote: Flame Seed and Fiery Teleportation; fly 30 ft
hb.atkNote: only while Spirit Merge is active

features.name: Spirit Merge: Fiery Teleportation
features.desc: You and each willing creature of your choice within 5 feet of you teleport up to 15 feet to unoccupied spaces you can see. Then each creature within 5 feet of the space you left must succeed on a Dexterity saving throw against your spell save DC or take 1d6 + PB fire damage.

features.name: Detect Good and Evil (Passive)
features.desc: Can detect Infernal and Celestial from 30 ft. as long as I'm using flames. In the presence of an Infernal, my flames turn bright red; In the presence of a Celestial, my flames turn bright white.

hb.adv: Saves against dragon breath weapons; Saves against Frightful Presence

inventory.name: Sentinel Shield
inventory.summary: Advantage on initiative rolls and Wisdom (Perception) checks.

hb.immune: Mind-reading and detection magic (thoughts / lies / alignment / creature type)

hb.text: Declare it before or while you cast a spell that calls for a saving throw: a dragon can't use Legendary Resistance against any save for that spell.
Coats one slashing or piercing weapon (or 3 pieces of ammunition) for 1 minute.
